prompt: The video begins with the viewer moving forward along a dimly lit path surrounded by dense fog, creating an eerie atmosphere. The camera smoothly transitions from a grassy area into a paved street lined with traditional Japanese lanterns and wooden buildings, their silhouettes barely visible through the mist. As the movement continues, the scene shifts to a stone-paved pathway leading towards a large torii gate, its red pillars standing out against the dark surroundings. The camera angle remains steady, focusing straight ahead as it ascends a flight of stairs flanked by more torii gates, each progressively smaller as they recede into the distance. The ambient lighting is minimal, with only a few lanterns casting a soft glow that barely penetrates the thick fog. The environment is completely devoid of people, enhancing the sense of solitude. The camera then pans slightly to the right, revealing a small fenced area with additional lanterns before continuing straight through a tunnel-like passage formed by closely spaced torii gates. The entire sequence maintains a slow, deliberate pace, emphasizing the quiet, mysterious ambiance of the night-time setting at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, Japan.
